# axm token revoke

Revoke a granular access token

## When to use

Revoke a granular access token

## Usage

```bash
axm token revoke [flags] <id>
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type   | Required | Description        |
| ---- | ------ | -------- | ------------------ |
| `id` | string | Yes      | Token id to revoke |

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Revoke a granular access token**

```bash
axm token revoke token_123
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
